description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) performance of three variants of the MADLLM model—MADLLM (light green), a second variant represented by a purple bar (likely a baseline or ablation, though unlabeled in the legend), and MADLLM without skip embedding (light orange)—across five multivariate anomaly detection benchmarks: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The vertical axis ranges from 80% to 100% F1 Score, with major ticks at 80, 90, and 100. For each dataset, the three bars are grouped side-by-side. MADLLM (light green) consistently achieves the highest or near-highest F1 Score across all datasets: ~93.5% on SMD, ~96.5% on PSM, ~91.5% on SWaT, ~93.5% on SMAP, and ~92.5% on MSL. The purple bar (second variant) performs slightly lower than MADLLM on SMD, PSM, SMAP, and MSL, but notably worse on SWaT (~86%). The “MADLLM w/o skip embedding” variant (light orange) generally underperforms compared to MADLLM, with scores around 90% on SMD, 92.5% on PSM, 86.5% on SWaT, 90% on SMAP, and 89.5% on MSL. The chart visually emphasizes the contribution of the skip embedding mechanism by showing consistent performance degradation when it is removed, and suggests that the purple bar may represent a different model or configuration that is outperformed by MADLLM in most cases.
